# Shobhit Tripathi

> Engineering leader who builds rigorous, AI-native platforms end to end. CTO / IT Director at NS Engineering; ex-Deloitte (7+ years, Technology Guild Guru); creator of Quantum Foundry, an open-source semiconductor simulator.
